candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns 500, so the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order's own 500 cause (db, payment, inventory) is not observed; only the gateway-side propagation is established.

report.explanation: Logs and traces show every checkout 502 paired with an order /v1/orders 500; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). Root cause lies in the order service, whose internal failure is not yet observed.
